title: A GC-MS-based exhaled VOC diagnostic model for distinguishing early-stage lung cancer from controls

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A GC-MS-based exhaled VOC diagnostic model for distinguishing early-stage lung cancer from controls》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】This study aimed to identify exhaled volatile organic compounds (VOCs) biomarkers and develop diagnostic models for stage I non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with exploratory subgroup analyses designed to preliminarily evaluate potential stage-specific heterogeneity.

evidence.text: This study aimed to identify exhaled volatile organic compounds (VOCs) biomarkers and develop diagnostic models for stage I non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with exploratory subgroup analyses designed to preliminarily evaluate potential stage-specific heterogeneity.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A GC-MS-based exhaled VOC diagnostic model for distinguishing early-stage lung cancer from controls》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Breath samples from 74 patients with stage I NSCLC (52 IA, 22 IB) and 75 healthy controls were analyzed using thermal desorption gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (TD-GC-MS).

evidence.text: Breath samples from 74 patients with stage I NSCLC (52 IA, 22 IB) and 75 healthy controls were analyzed using thermal desorption gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (TD-GC-MS).

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《A GC-MS-based exhaled VOC diagnostic model for distinguishing early-stage lung cancer from controls》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】An RBF-kernel SVM model achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.991 (0.956-1.000), with 93.3% (95% CI: 70.2-98.8%) sensitivity and 93.3% (95% CI: 70.2-98.8%) specificity in the test set.

【Abstract · abstract-1-11】Additionally, a simplified two-VOC logistic regression model (cyclohexane and diethylsilane) yielded an AUC of 0.708.

evidence.text: An RBF-kernel SVM model achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.991 (0.956-1.000), with 93.3% (95% CI: 70.2-98.8%) sensitivity and 93.3% (95% CI: 70.2-98.8%) specificity in the test set.
Additionally, a simplified two-VOC logistic regression model (cyclohexane and diethylsilane) yielded an AUC of 0.708.
